title: The Tithe of Hair
text: Each morning one of your Scions wakes with a lock of hair cut away. The doors are barred. The windows are shut. The cut is clean, and very close to the throat, and the pillow beside it is always warm.

options.label: Set a watch through the night.

outcomes.text: The watch sees a child-sized shadow at the bedside, and chases it into a wall. The cutting stops.
The watch falls asleep at the stroke of three, every time. In the morning it is the watcher's hair that is cut.

options.label: Leave a lock out each night, willingly.

outcomes.text: The offering is taken, and the House's luck holds that Year.
The offering is taken. The next week, two locks.

options.label: Shave every head in the House.

outcomes.text: The House goes shorn, and the town laughs, and the cutting stops.
